annotations.title: Change a video edit by saying what you want

description: Change a post's video edit with one plain sentence, like "make it shorter and punchier", "open with the finished plate", "fewer effects", "make the captions bigger and yellow", "quieter music" or "undo that". The sentence is read by code against a fixed list of changes (see edit_instruct_examples); every change in it is made together as one new rev, and each result says what changed in plain words or why it could not. unresolved lists the parts of the sentence that matched nothing. What no rule reads is tried as a free-form edit on Creator, Studio and Brand plans within the AI allowance. Pass base_rev; EDIT_CONFLICT means get the edit again.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.
